title: AgentBundleProfile
description: Bundle-side spec; deploy script translates into a Tangle Sandbox AgentProfile and emits harness-native files (AGENTS.md, agents.json) at the workspace root.

workspace.description: Sandbox workspace layout. Defaults to OpenCode/Claude/Hermes harness convention at /home/agent.

root.description: Absolute path inside the sandbox where AGENTS.md, agents.json, and resource files are emitted. Defaults to /home/agent.

systemPromptFile.description: Relative path to the orchestrator's system prompt. Conventionally AGENTS.md (auto-loaded by the harness); content is also pushed via AgentProfile.prompt.systemPrompt.

subagents.description: For multi-agent bundles only. Each entry is emitted into <workspace.root>/agents.json under the OpenCode subagent shape: { mode: 'subagent', description, prompt, tools, permission, temperature }.

source.description: Relative to bundle root; file or directory.

target.description: Path inside the sandbox. If relative, treated as relative to <workspace.root>. Defaults to <workspace.root>/<source>.
